title: Punishment for non-compliance with direction
description: Punishment for failing to comply with order made by the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission

content.offence: Failing to comply with order made by the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission
content.minimum: one month or twenty-five thousand rupees
content.maximum: three years or one lakh rupees
